about.title: About
about.description: Passionate about Artificial Intelligence and Mobile development, I am committed to delivering robust and scalable solutions. My approach is driven by scientific rigor and a constant desire to push the boundaries of technology to solve real-world problems.

exp1.desc: Intensive Generative AI training from A to Z: mastering LLM architectures, designing RAG pipelines, advanced prompt engineering and AI agent development. Hands-on experience on real-world projects integrating Langchain, ChromaDB and cutting-edge models.

exp2.desc: Voluntary contribution within the Web Dev & Solutions team: designing and developing professional websites, integrating digital solutions and actively participating in collaborative projects focused on social impact.

services.title: My Services
services.subtitle: Custom technological solutions to propel your business forward

s1.title: AI Chatbots & Intelligent Agents
s1.desc: Automate your customer relations with custom AI assistants. Design of intelligent conversational agents using Langchain, Chainlit and the latest LLM models.

s2.title: RAG Solutions & Vector Databases
s2.desc: Harness the power of your private data with AI. Implementation of retrieval-augmented generation systems with ChromaDB, Pinecone and Weaviate.

s3.title: Mobile Applications
s3.desc: High-performance cross-platform apps with Flutter & Dart. Elegant interfaces and premium user experiences on iOS and Android.

s4.title: Websites & Business Pages
s4.desc: Modern, responsive professional websites for businesses. Premium design, SEO optimized and guaranteed performance for your online presence.

s5.title: Cloud Backend Integration
s5.desc: Scalable backend architecture with Firebase and Supabase. Authentication, real-time database, storage and high-performance cloud deployment.

s6.title: AI Consulting & Strategy
s6.desc: Technical audit and strategic consulting to integrate AI into your business. Identifying automation opportunities and custom implementation plan.
